result.instructions: Tools for Planerio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the shifts of the next 7 days and who works the night shift."; "Who is absent next week? Include the requests that wait for approval."; "Which shift groups have open staffing requirements in December?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Planerio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run planerio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run planerio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run planerio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. planerio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: planerio_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List the planned shifts between two dates: shift id, start and end time, employee (name, personnel number, employee_uuid), shift group, workplace, location, tags and last change. By default only published plans and no deleted shifts. Use updated_after for changes since a date. Sorted by start time. Read-only. Long lists are cut: use offset to continue.

updated_after.description: Only shifts changed after this date.

include_drafts.description: Also shifts from plans in draft status.

include_comments.description: Add the free-text shift comments. Slower and larger.

offset.description: Rows to skip (use next_offset of a truncated reply).

tools.name: planerio_list_shift_cards
tools.title: List staffing requirements (shift cards)
tools.description: List the staffing requirement defined in shift cards: workplace, location, shift group, validity, weekdays, times, shift type, required qualifications and the shifts of each card with priority and pre-planned employee. Filter by validity dates. Read-only.

start_date.description: Leave out cards that ended before this date.

end_date.description: Leave out cards that start after this date.

offset.description: Rows to skip (use next_offset of a truncated reply).

tools.name: planerio_list_staff
tools.title: List available staff (resource planning)
tools.description: List the current staff supply for resource planning: name, personnel number, primary shift group, qualifications, weekly hours and days, hours per weekday, entry and exit date. Use it together with planerio_list_shift_cards. For plain employee master data use planerio_list_employees. Read-only.

offset.description: Rows to skip (use next_offset of a truncated reply).

tools.name: planerio_list_employees
tools.title: List employees (master data)
tools.description: List the employee master data valid on a reference date: employee_uuid, names, email, personnel number, shift groups, entry and exit date, work schedule (weekly hours, job title, tariff), supervisor, cost center, occupational category, date of birth. Personal data: ask only for what the task needs. Read-only.

reference_date.description: Day for which the data is valid, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

offset.description: Rows to skip (use next_offset of a truncated reply).

tools.name: planerio_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List the absence periods that overlap two dates: employee, dates and times, calendar and working days, status (ACCEPTED, OPEN, REJECTED, DELETED), absence type and comment. By default only approved absences. Use include_open for requests that wait for approval. Read-only. Long lists are cut: use offset to continue.

include_open.description: Also absences that wait for approval.

include_recurring.description: Also single dates of recurring absences.

include_days.description: One row per calendar day with cost_in_days, cost_in_hours and day_segment. Changes the reply shape.

updated_after.description: Only absences changed after this date.

offset.description: Rows to skip (use next_offset of a truncated reply).

tools.name: planerio_get_vacation_days
tools.title: Get vacation budget
tools.description: Get the vacation days per employee for one year: allowance, carry-over from the last year, expired, requested, approved, taken and remaining. Only for Planerio 1.5 (not 2.0); Planerio replaces this endpoint in 2026/27. Read-only.

date.description: A day in the year to calculate, for example 2026-01-01. Days taken count up to this day.

offset.description: Rows to skip (use next_offset of a truncated reply).
